ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level high-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface, with a high-contrast transition to low-intensity (black) pixels along the trailing edge and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central region spanning both lobes. A continuous black pigment band follows the trailing edge. Distinct reddish-brown linear mark on the upper right lobe. Dark focal spots clustered near the inferior peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 82 degrees and a depth ratio of 1:8 relative to the fluke's vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous chain of irregular serrations; high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (5-10 pixels) along the central trailing edge, transitioning to jagged, high-amplitude prominences at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the majority of the trailing edge, meeting a tapered convex curve at the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of dark, high-contrast pixel groups located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, breaking the white/black boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical reddish-brown linear disruption on the right lobe surface; several faint horizontal gray linear marks visible on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable vertical reddish-brown mark on the right fluke; irregular, potentially necrotic or traumatic jaggedness at the tip perimeters.
other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct dark focal spots located at the center-bottom of the fluke just above the notch.
